visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with reddish hair in a plaid shirt stands in a modern bathroom, looking at a stained sink counter with a frustrated expression. (2) A man in a black t-shirt enters and gestures confidently toward the sink while talking to the woman. (3) The man holds a clear spray bottle labeled 'Goodies & Co.' and a green cloth, explaining its use to the camera. (4) The man sprays the product onto a mirror and the dirty marble-textured countertop; the liquid foams slightly on the surface. (5) Using the green cloth, the man wipes the surfaces, which immediately become reflective and clean, highlighted by star-shaped graphics. (6) A split-screen comparison shows a water-spotted glass door on the left labeled 'Before' and a sparkling clean one on the right labeled 'After'. (7) The woman looks at the cleaned sink with an exaggerated expression of surprise and delight, nodding as the man speaks. (8) The man continues to clean the glass shower door, demonstrating the product's effectiveness on water spots with a green sponge. (9) The couple stands together, smiling; the woman hugs the man and waves at the camera while the clear cleaning bottle is showcased at the end.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched female vocals express frustration with an distressed tone, accompanied by the faint sound of running water in a resonant bathroom setting. (2) A male voice with a calm, deeper pitch and moderate conversational loudness responds, followed by the start of an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic pop BGM with a bright piano melody. (3) Repeated sharp, broadband 'sh-sh' spray sound effects occur as the man narrates in a friendly, professional tone, describing cleaning efficiency. (4) High-frequency 'ding' and 'sparkle' SFX are edited in to emphasize the cleaning results, mixed with the rhythmic rustling of a cloth wiping a hard surface. (5) The female voice returns with high arousal, yelling 'Wow!' in an excited tone as the BGM maintains a steady, rhythmic guitar-led beat. (6) The man provides detailed narration about the product's natural ingredients with clear articulation and high dominance, while the BGM plays continuously. (7) A loud liquid splash and rinsing sound are heard as shower glass is cleaned, followed by the female laughing and cheering with a joyful valence. (8) The audio concludes with a cheerful vocal sign-off from both speakers and a final cartoon-style pop SFX as the BGM flourishes and fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and endorse 'Goodies & Co.' cleaning spray by demonstrating its effectiveness on bathroom stains and its eco-friendly, non-toxic properties through a humorous couple interaction.
